## Why it matters

The Schweizerisches Wirtschaftsarchiv at the University of Basel preserves more than 600 business archives from 1750 to the present, with a regional focus on Basel.

Its search portals, archival structures, and digitised holdings make it a strong entry point for Swiss economic, business, labour, and industrial history.
